newsItems.title: Meta Sued Over Training Data for Its AI and Face-Recognition Systems
newsItems.summary: The proposed class action alleges Meta illegally harvested people’s Facebook and Instagram photos to train its AI image-generation models and to build its unreleased “NameTag” face recognition feature.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 基础模型能力、价格和开放策略的变化，会迅速传导到整个应用生态。
newsItems.titleZh: Meta起诉其人工智能和人脸识别系统的训练数据
newsItems.summaryZh: 拟议的集体诉讼指控Meta非法获取人们的Facebook和Instagram照片，以训练其AI图像生成模型并构建其未发布的“NameTag”人脸识别功能。

newsItems.title: An Anthropic researcher’s doomsday warning comes at a very interesting time
newsItems.summary: An Anthropic researcher resigned this week, warning in a post on X that the company is “racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives”. The company’s own alignment lead even co-signed the message rather than walking it back. It’s the kind of doo…
newsItems.whyItMatters: 新研究可能改变模型能力边界，但仍需要复现、评测与同行检验。
newsItems.titleZh: Anthropic研究人员的世界末日警告发生在一个非常有趣的时刻
newsItems.summaryZh: Anthropic的一名研究人员本周辞职，他在X上的一篇帖子中警告说，该公司正在“直奔自我提升的超级智能，用我们的生命赌博”。 该公司自己的对齐领导甚至共同签署了信息，而不是把它带回去。 就是那种嘟嘟声……
